caption: The drawing depicts a centered rectangular section of a woven textile on a plain, off-white or beige background. The textile design consists of an interlocking geometric pattern made with dark blue and off-white threads. The central part of the textile features a square motif bordered by straight lines, with diamond and floral-like geometric shapes arranged symmetrically around it. The pattern is gridded, with the blue portions dominating and the off-white details forming the pattern itself. The edges of the textile are straight, and the overall weaving appears tight and even. Near the lower right corner of the paper, there is a small handwritten signature in blue ink that reads "C. Christoffels." The textile sample occupies the central area of the sheet, with ample blank space around it.
title: Coverlet (Section of)
